Celebrities Attend Anshula Kapoor's Wedding Reception

Several Bollywood celebrities attended Anshula Kapoor's wedding reception. Attendees included Janhvi Kapoor, who wore a silk saree and strapless blouse, and reportedly gave a nod to her boyfriend Shikhar Pahariya through her mehndi design. Ranveer Singh and Arjun Kapoor were seen dancing to a song from their film 'Gunday'. Other guests included Himesh Reshammiya and Karan Johar, who performed a towel dance.
